entry_point: Included processed benchmark tables and binary region-by-experiment overlaps. No reporter outcome is used to fit the CRISPR predictor.

reference.selection: TFs and others; 500–300000 peaks and valid alignment/duplicate metrics; up to eight represented cell labels per target; union of best alignment and estimated unique-read experiments in each label; benchmark-associated source series excluded where identifiable.

source_and_fivecell.mapping: Gene symbol and any interval overlap; mean raw covariates and mean published Score across matches. Eight native features retained. Missing native coverage is excluded from fitting and receives zero in full-universe evaluation.

astrocyte.note: Two feature configurations of the same screen, not independent studies.

reporter.preprocessing: Unmodified 500P/78P sequences; unique length-preserving hg19-to-hg38 mapping; sequence and strand checked; clean-TSS and finite-response filters. Seven intervals occur in both libraries.
reporter.response: The source annotations P_resp field: the authors fitted promoter-responsiveness parameter summarizing sensitivity to enhancer-driven reporter expression; it is used only as an evaluation outcome.

annotation.policy: Transcript TSS clusters span <=200 bp; representative selected by APPRIS principal rank, basic tag, then transcript length. All clusters retained.

candidate_index: 1 kb bins with peak midpoints from at least three of the fixed reference experiments, chromosomes 1–22/X/Y; public support, not functionally validated enhancers.
evaluation: Retrospective evaluation; external cohorts informed model selection. The four-gene screen is a candidate-search analysis, not an independent test.
data_rights: Derived numerical benchmarks and public annotations retain their source terms. The repository code license does not relicense third-party data.
distance_strata: Use benchmark_distance (the original benchmark distance), not the matched feature-file distance or an interval-midpoint approximation.

public_atlas_inference.dnase: ENCODE accessions in public_atlas.json; measured hg38 accessibility integrated into 1 kb windows.
public_atlas_inference.contact_normalization: SCALE at 5 kb; not substituted into native rE2G covariates
public_atlas_inference.training: Separate gene-only and cell-reference logistic fits on source CRISPR labels; matching public DNase is used when available.

processed_analysis_inputs.public_features.npz: Row-aligned public annotation/contact features, five measured activity features, availability masks and fixed-K562 activity for source/fivecell/astrocyte; no private query assays.
processed_analysis_inputs.public_scores.npz: Saved predictions used as numerical expectations, not substitutes for fresh fits; output keys identify each analysis.
processed_analysis_inputs.candidate_screen.csv.gz: Four-gene CREST-seq candidate windows, screen annotations and scores for seven methods evaluated on identical eligible windows.
processed_analysis_inputs.candidate_retrieval.csv.gz: Pair-level candidate retrieval results for the processed CRISPR benchmarks.

annotated_candidates.transcript_policy: MANE Select, then Ensembl canonical; coordinates use zero-based half-open intervals.
annotated_candidates.mask_policy: Target-gene CDS across annotated translated transcripts, selected-transcript 5-prime UTR and selected TSS +/-1 kb; retain other-gene promoters

enhancer_target_query.candidate_annotation: Included GENCODE genes and TSS clusters; all gene types; same chromosome within 1 Mb of enhancer midpoint; no expression or screened-gene filter and no cap; valid promoter windows only.
enhancer_target_query.gene_pooling: CAGE-usage-weighted mean candidate-promoter score per Ensembl gene, multiplied by public transcription detection support. Promoter weights are proportional to CAGE CPM + 0.1 within each gene. All candidate genes are retained; stable identifiers break ties.
enhancer_target_query.raw_score_comparator: Maximum candidate-promoter score is retained as raw_max_pair_score and evaluated separately by target-benchmark without CAGE support.
enhancer_target_query.primary_analysis: query-analysis; reference_results/query_source_summary.csv, query_pair_summary.csv and query_summary.csv reproduce the matched source, screened-pair and transcription-supported target-query analyses.
enhancer_target_query.frozen_predictions: reference_results/target_promoter_scores.csv.gz; all promoter inputs and scores from the supplied public model.
enhancer_target_query.benchmark: Existing coordinate-valid five-cell CRISPR data; 174 positive-bearing enhancer/cell/study queries; primary target-choice subset: 60 with at least two assayed genes. Deployed Atlas-E2G coefficients remain fixed; matched binding ablations are refitted only on source CRISPR labels.
enhancer_target_query.comparator_processing: Any enhancer interval overlap; strip Ensembl gene version; mean ABC.Score.Feature and Score within each query and gene; restrict all methods to the same annotation/published intersection for comparison. No missing scores are invented.
enhancer_target_query.outcomes: All known-positive target ranks, query-level Top-1/Top-3 hits, positive-target recall and coverage. Missing candidates count as missed; unassayed genes remain unknown. Distal positive outcomes retain proximal competitors.
enhancer_target_query.intervals: 2000 paired enhancer-coordinate cluster bootstrap draws: seed 20261102 for the principal transcription-supported query-analysis and seed 84627 for the separate raw maximum-score target-benchmark comparator; retrospective uncertainty.

public_transcription.use: Promoter-usage weights and detection support; no functional labels.
